races.title: PricedUp Now With Best Odds 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: An interesting maiden. EASTERN ROCK shaped better than the distance beaten suggests on his hurdling debut at Fontwell last month, paying the price for a big move into contention, and looks sure to build on that promise. Ivor Bear was no match for a speedier sort on his first go over hurdles at this course recently but can be expected to improve upped in trip, while multiple-winning Irish pointer Supreme Force also commands plenty of respect for an in-form stable. EASTERN ROCK (IRE) IVOR BEAR (IRE) SUPREME FORCE (IRE)

races.verdict: TELL THE TALE surpassed his hurdles form when making a winning chase debut at Ffos Las last month and he can follow up from a 6 lb higher mark. Catwalk Girl also made a winning start over fences back in the spring and is respected, with Western George appealing as one who should do better now chasing. TELL THE TALE (IRE) CATWALK GIRL (IRE) WESTERN GEORGE (IRE)
